extracted.intended_audience: readers/fans of the artist's comics and people who may share the images online
extracted.subtask_description: A creator's online archive page for short, silly comics and doodles that explains sharing expectations and links to original posts. The page functions as a partial collection with metadata about recent updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permission to share with attribution
rubrics_metrics.description: feel free to share them, but if you do, please link back to this website or my bsky/twitter ♥
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sharing is explicitly permitted provided a link-back to the site or the creator's social (bsky/twitter) is included. The creator requests attribution; no further licensing terms are provided on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image provenance / link to original post
rubrics_metrics.description: each image has a link to the original post too :)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Every image on the archive links to its original post, enabling viewers to find the source/context. Users should prefer linking to the original post when referencing or sharing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Archive completeness disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: it's not a comprehensive archive, but it's a good chunk!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The archive is explicitly partial — visitors should not expect a complete collection. This sets the expectation that some comics/doodles may be missing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content tone and type
rubrics_metrics.description: here you can find various silly comics & doodles i've drawn
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies the comics as informal, humorous ('silly') doodles drawn by the site owner — useful for setting audience expectations about style and register.

rubrics_metrics.name: Update/recency metadata
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page displays a latest-update timestamp, signaling when the archive was last amended. Readers can use this to assess how current the collection is.
